questions.question: Whom does Isaiah 55 invite to come to the waters?
options: Only those who are able to pay the full price in silver
Only the priests and the Levites who serve in the temple
Everyone who thirsts, and he who has no money
Only the kings and the great princes of all the nations
questions.answer: Everyone who thirsts, and he who has no money

questions.question: What does God say about his word in Isaiah 55?
options: It shall be hidden away entirely from the eyes of all men
It shall return at last to him again with all of their praises
It shall not return empty but accomplish what he purposes
It shall pass quickly away, just like the grass of the field
questions.answer: It shall not return empty but accomplish what he purposes

questions.question: Isaiah 55 says God's thoughts and ways are higher than ours, as the heavens are higher than the earth.
Seek the LORD while he may be found; call upon him while he is _____.
So shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me _____.
